i.norm: Tests that {@link SpatialContextFactory#makeSpatialContext} returns a context whose class, geo mode, distance calculator, and world bounds all match those of the canonical {@link SpatialContext#GEO} singleton when no configuration arguments are supplied.
System property key used by {@link SpatialContextFactory} to select a factory class.

Builds a {@link SpatialContext} via {@link SpatialContextFactory#makeSpatialContext} using the supplied key-value pairs as configuration arguments. @param keyValuePairs alternating key, value strings passed to the factory @return the constructed {@link SpatialContext}

Verifies that a factory created with no arguments produces a {@link SpatialContext} that is equivalent to {@link SpatialContext#GEO} in terms of concrete class, geo mode, distance calculator, and world bounds.
No arguments → factory should fall back to all defaults
